observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR body marked D3300 with a body cap on, sitting on a Nikon box.
Photo 0 shows a black Nikon lens marked AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II with hood and cap.
Photo 1 shows the same camera and lens on the same box from a slightly different angle.
The box in both photos is labeled Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II Kit.
No battery, charger, strap, or memory card is visible in either photo.
The lens front element is visible but not in macro detail, so fungus or fine scratches cannot be confirmed or ruled out.
The seller sent a text reply claiming personal testing but provided no new photos or screenshots.
